definitions.rationale: This equation defines the named mathematical summary largestEvenInRange(X, Y) as the parity-adjusted upper endpoint when it lies in the interval, and -1 otherwise.
definitions.text:
rule largestEvenInRange(X:Int, Y:Int)
    => #if X <=Int Y -Int pyMod(Y, 2)
       #then Y -Int pyMod(Y, 2)
       #else -1
       #fi

operational_rules.rationale: This execution wrapper rewrites #chooseNum(X, Y) to a call of the closure containing the translated choose_num body, allowing symbolic inputs to run under the supplied Python semantics.
operational_rules.text:
rule <k> #chooseNum(X:Int, Y:Int)
        => Call(
             closureVal(
               ("x", "y"),
               If(
                 Compare(BinOp("%", Name("y"), Int(2)), CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
                 If(
                   Compare(Name("y"), CmpOp(">=", Name("x"))),
                   Return(Name("y")),
                   .Stmts)
                 Return(UnaryOp("-", Int(1))),
                 .Stmts)
               If(
                 Compare(
                   BinOp("-", Name("y"), Int(1)),
                   CmpOp(">=", Name("x"))),
                 Return(BinOp("-", Name("y"), Int(1))),
                 .Stmts)
               Return(UnaryOp("-", Int(1))),
               0),
             X, Y)
        ... </k>
